title: Elasticsearch
description: A vector database component for Elasticsearch, enabling efficient storage and
retrieval of vector embeddings. It supports similarity search, filtering,
and management of vector data with high performance. Supports Elastic Cloud
Serverless, Elastic Cloud Hosted, and self-managed Elasticsearch deployments.

elasticsearch.cloud.host.description: Enter the Elastic Cloud host e.g. <your-deployment-id>.es.<region>.cloud.es.io

elasticsearch.index.title: Index Name / Collection Name
elasticsearch.index.description: Enter the name of the Elasticsearch index (must be lowercase)

elasticsearch.mode.title: Store Mode
elasticsearch.mode.description: Vector store (semantic search over embeddings) or index (BM25 text search). Pick it before the first ingest: the index mapping differs between the two.

elasticsearch.search.title: Customize Indexing Search Behavior
elasticsearch.search.description: Customize the search behavior of the index with the options below. This option does not affect the ingestion and creation of the index. You can switch between behaviors when searching between pipeline runs.

elasticsearch.matchOperator.title: Match Operator
description: Controls how multiple query terms are matched:
'or' (default) matches documents containing ANY of the query terms,
'and' matches documents containing ALL of the query terms,
'exact' requires the exact phrase to appear in order (phrase matching).

elasticsearch.slop.title: Slop
elasticsearch.slop.description: The number of words to allow between terms when exact phrase search is enabled.

elasticsearch.highlight.title: Return contextual snippets
elasticsearch.highlight.description: Use the unified highlighter to return snippets around matches.

elasticsearch.fragment_size.title: Snippet size (characters)
elasticsearch.fragment_size.description: Maximum characters in the returned highlight snippet (context window) per hit.
